name: Taris
summary: Taris is fully wrapped in Techno Black Walnut veneer, covering both the shelf and column in a deep, refined wood grain. The continuous finish creates a cohesive, sculptural look with a rich, contemporary warmth. The shelf and column all cover with Techno black walnut veneer 204.5×44.5×188
